page_title: STU 5-0 BOC | Stuttgart v Bochum 19/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
85' Borna Sosa (VfB Stuttgart) will take a corner kick.
84' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Borna Sosa (VfB Stuttgart). Stuttgart force a corner. They send men into the box.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) leaves the pitch and Jovan Milosevic comes on.
80' Thomas Letsch has decided to make a change. Noah Loosli (Bochum) replaces Anthony Losilla.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Roberto Massimo (VfB Stuttgart) comes onto the pitch so that Pascal Stenzel can be given a rest.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Borna Sosa (VfB Stuttgart) is coming onto the pitch as Hiroki Ito cannot continue after picking up an injury.
78' It's time for a substitution. Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) comes on in place of Silas.
78' Here is a change. Atakan Karazor is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Lilian Egloff (VfB Stuttgart).
77' 5 - 0 Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
72' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 8:1.
69' Substitution. Kevin Stoger makes way for Patrick Osterhage (Bochum).
68' Thomas Letsch has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lukas Daschner (Bochum) replacing Takuma Asano.

67' 4 - 0 Silas (VfB Stuttgart) meets a perfect cross from Pascal Stenzel deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces a low shot into the middle of the goal. The score has changed to 4:0.
66' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
65' Here comes a substitution. Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) is brought on as a substitute for Christopher Antwi-Adjei.
63' The resulting set piece from Stuttgart is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
60' 3 - 0 Chris Fuhrich takes the free kick and finds Silas (VfB Stuttgart) just outside the six-yard box. He keeps his cool and puts the ball into the back of the net. The score is 3:0.
57' Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniel Siebert blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Bochum.
56' Stuttgart force their opponents to concede a corner.
56' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Now Stuttgart have a corner.
54' It will be a corner kick for Stuttgart.

53' Simon Zoller (Bochum) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniel Siebert with no other option than to blow for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Stuttgart.

48' Golden chance! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
46' A player from Stuttgart commits a rough challenge. Daniel Siebert blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Free kick. Bochum will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
46' Half-time substitution. Thomas Letsch decided to make a change. Philipp Hofmann is replaced by Simon Zoller (Bochum).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+6' The ball goes out for a corner. Stuttgart can continue in their attacking effort.

45+6' Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the top left corner. However, Manuel Riemann anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
45+4' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart) for his blatant foul.
45+1' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniel Siebert had an easy-decision to make.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
43' Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Stuttgart are awarded a corner kick.
38' 2 - 0 Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a bullet header from close range into the middle of the net. The score is 2:0.
38' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
38' Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Stuttgart win a corner.

34' Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Manuel Riemann!
33' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
32' One of the Bochum players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. A free kick is awarded to Stuttgart.
27' Takuma Asano (Bochum) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
26' One of the players from Stuttgart times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
23' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Bochum is cautioned for aggressive play. Stuttgart have a free kick.
20' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) is able to continue to play.
19' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

18' 1 - 0 Stunning strike! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) latches on to a through ball from Hiroki Ito and surprises the goalkeeper with a shot from the edge of the box that goes into the middle of the goal. The score is now 1:0.
16' A cooling break is underway.
15' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) dribbles into the box, but Manuel Riemann is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
13' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
12' Felix Passlack (Bochum) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Stuttgart will take a free kick.
9' The possession of the ball – 58:42.
7' Some patient build-up play from Stuttgart as they look to unlock the defence.
5' Stuttgart try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
5' Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
4' Bernardo (Bochum) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniel Siebert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

2' Good chance! Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
1' A pass from Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) is intercepted by Manuel Riemann and the move breaks down.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Bochum will have the kick-off.
Daniel Siebert will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
